title: Julius Baer Inflows Slow as Client Risk Cleanup Continues
summary: Julius Baer's client inflows slowed in the first ten months of the year. The Swiss wealth manager continues cleaning up its client book following a regulator probe.

title: Asian regulators rush to support sagging markets as AI trade falters
summary: Asian regulators are rushing to support sagging markets as the AI trade falters. Chipmakers and hardware suppliers are especially vulnerable to the turn in sentiment.

title: Swiss Bourse Owner SIX Steps Up Effort to Attract Growth Stocks
summary: SIX Group, owner of the Swiss stock exchange, is stepping up efforts to attract growth companies to its listing venues. It aims to fend off competition from private capital and US exchanges.

title: Más mexicanos, menos viviendas y muchos obstáculos para construirlas
summary: México requiere más vivienda económica, pero se construye mucho menos: según Infonavit, de enero a julio de 2025 se edificaron apenas 20,000 viviendas económicas y populares, frente a 140,100 en el mismo periodo de 2015 (-85.7%). En contraste, la vivienda media y residencial creció de 10,600 a 17,200 unidades, y la Sedatu estima 8.33 millones de viviendas en rezago habitacional.

title: Earnings Could Signal When to Buy the AI Dip: JPMorgan
summary: JPMorgan's James Sullivan says earnings revisions may signal when to buy back into AI stocks. Nvidia sank 14% on Friday, Anthropic fell 8.5% on its second day of trading and a chipmaker gauge dropped 11%.

title: Casonas de Puebla, patrimonio que busca inversiones para su recuperación
summary: Las casonas del Centro Histórico de Puebla son una oportunidad de inversión inmobiliaria, turística y comercial para hoteles boutique, restaurantes, oficinas o vivienda. Sin embargo, enfrentan abandono, deterioro estructural y altos costos de rehabilitación, además de las restricciones de conservación patrimonial.

title: Sector obrero propone alza de 15% al salario mínimo; piden eliminar el MIR
summary: El sector obrero propuso en la Conasami un alza de 15% al salario mínimo para 2027 y pidió eliminar el Monto Independiente de Recuperación (MIR). El Consejo de Representantes entrará en sesión permanente el 26 de noviembre y los sectores tienen hasta el 30 para presentar propuestas.

title: Seis claves para proteger a tu empresa del fraude financiero
summary: Los fraudes financieros contra empresas se sofistican: una llamada, un correo o un WhatsApp pueden comprometer recursos e información confidencial. La IA multiplica las posibilidades de engaño, aunque muchas vulnerabilidades siguen originándose en prácticas administrativas cotidianas y en la falta de controles básicos.

title: Busca Xochitepec transformación y consolidación con nuevas inversiones
summary: Xochitepec, Morelos, nombrado Pueblo Mágico, busca atraer inversiones con más servicios, infraestructura y desarrollos residenciales. Proyectos como Almanta (con clústeres como Alaya) apuntan a compradores de segunda residencia o que quieran vivir de forma permanente en el municipio.

title: The problem with the circular AI economy
summary: FT examines the risks of the circular AI economy built on Nvidia's vendor financing. The piece asks what happens if that 'Jenga tower' collapses.

title: Emerging-Market Stocks Set to Erase 2026 Gains on AI Selloff
summary: Emerging-market stocks are on track to erase their 2026 gains. Mounting doubts about the sustainability of the AI trade are fueling a global selloff stretching from the US to Asia.

title: AI Investment Adding to Inflation: Jain
summary: Westpac economist Illiana Jain expects further Fed rate hikes to tame inflation, with AI investment adding to price pressures. She says the AI boom also masks weakness in broader investment outside the sector.

title: Trump's AI Chip Crackdown on China After Nvidia Crisis Squeezes Southeast Asia
summary: Washington's new AI chip export rulebook threatens a multibillion-dollar cloud business powering Southeast Asia's data center boom. Data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia fall under the rules.

title: Inteligencia artificial y finanzas: cómo la usan los adolescentes argentinos para consultar sobre inversiones
summary: Más de la mitad de los adolescentes argentinos (52%) ya usó herramientas de inteligencia artificial para consultas sobre dinero, ahorro e inversión, según un informe de BBVA, Junior Achievement y la Universidad Torcuato Di Tella. El estudio, con 4,144 jóvenes, muestra a la IA como nueva fuente de educación financiera.

title: How much more air can come out of the AI trade?
summary: The Economist asks how much further the AI trade can deflate. Markets are troubled, it argues, for good reason.

title: OpenAI Chief Scientist Urges Industry Limits on AI Development
summary: OpenAI's chief scientist proposed that AI companies agree to limits on developing increasingly powerful models. The pause would hold until researchers have better ways to understand and monitor model behavior.

title: How AI is Accelerating Cyberattacks
summary: Cyberattacks spiked in 2020 and have stayed elevated, threatening businesses and critical infrastructure. Experts say AI is accelerating both attacks and defenses, but currently gives criminals the upper hand.

title: Apple’s AI Agent War, Early 2027 Product Plans and iPhone Duo Face Unlock Review
summary: Bloomberg's Apple newsletter examines Apple's position in the race for AI agents. It also previews a slew of new iPhones, iPads and Macs planned for early 2027.

title: ¿Cuáles fueron las 10 OPI con mayores alzas en su debut? Anthropic y SpaceX, fuera del listado
summary: 2026 quedará marcado por los debuts bursátiles de Anthropic y SpaceX, las dos mayores OPI de la historia, con Anthropic superando el récord de recaudación de la empresa de Elon Musk. Sin embargo, según un informe de XTB, ninguna figura entre las diez OPI con mayores alzas en su primer día de cotización.

title: Rosaleda Terrace / RH-EL
summary: Rosaleda Terrace by RH-EL is a garden terrace project hidden behind a residence in Villahermosa, Tabasco. The property sits on the Laguna de las Ilusiones, with views of local fauna such as Morelet's crocodiles, manatees and birds.

title: Nvidia Board Faces a Governance Reckoning
summary: Bloomberg Opinion's Gautam Mukunda argues Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia has exposed broader governance problems, with the board under pressure to bring him back as investigations and possible shareholder litigation loom. He says Silicon Valley's concentration of power in founder CEOs weakens board oversight.

title: Governors Call for Federal AI Rules Without Sidelining States
summary: A bipartisan group of US governors is urging Washington to set rules for the most powerful AI systems. They want federal standards that still let states protect consumers, workers and children from AI risks.

title: Modern and Mexican: Mario Pani’s CUPA Housing Complex in Mexico City
summary: ArchDaily revisits Mario Pani's CUPA complex in Colonia del Valle, commissioned in 1947 as 200 houses for government employees. Pani instead proposed a 13-story building with more than a thousand apartments, green areas and communal spaces, opened in 1949 and now a landmark of Latin American modern architecture.

title: Nvidia pierde más de 20% en bolsa en una semana y ahora la SEC indaga sus cuentas
summary: Nvidia acumula una caída de más de 20% en bolsa en una semana. Además, la SEC abrió una indagatoria sobre sus cuentas.
